Cloud / Server Inference: 50 ms – 350 ms (Round-trip includes network hops, TLS handshake, HTTP parsing, server inference). Cold starts > 500 ms.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: 0.010 ms – 0.54 ms (Direct on-chip execution on Xtensa LX7 @ 240 MHz with ESP-NN SIMD). Zero network jitter.
Edge Advantage: Edge is 100x to 10,000x faster and strictly deterministic.
Doorbell Application Context: Permits instant real-time OLED/e-ink display updates and immediate local alerts without buffering.

Cloud / Server Inference: Telemetry (voltage, daily rings, RSSI, temperature, age) transmitted over public Internet to remote servers. Subject to interception, cloud breaches, and GDPR/CCPA data compliance.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: 100% on-device data processing. Raw electrical and environmental telemetry never leaves the doorbell's local memory.
Edge Advantage: Complete cryptographic isolation and zero attack surface for user telemetry.
Doorbell Application Context: Homeowner behavioral patterns (e.g., ring frequency indicating when occupants are home) remain private.

Cloud / Server Inference: Recurring Operational Expenses (OpEx): Cloud compute (AWS EC2/Lambda), API Gateway, TLS certificates, egress bandwidth, database storage, and 24/7 DevOps maintenance. Scales linearly with user base.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: One-time Capital Expense (CapEx): ESP32-S3 SoC costs ~$2.50 to $3.50. Zero recurring cloud compute, zero server hosting bills.
Edge Advantage: Zero marginal cost per inference; fixed bill-of-materials (BOM).
Doorbell Application Context: Enables profitable one-time hardware sales model without requiring subscription fees.

Cloud / Server Inference: Doorbell must wake 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi radio (TX: 240-310 mA, RX: 80-100 mA), perform AP association, DHCP, TLS negotiation, and HTTP POST (takes 2.0 to 4.5 seconds). Consumes ~1.5 to 3.0 Joules per reading.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: Wi-Fi radio remains in Deep Sleep. CPU wakes up, reads ADC/I2C sensors, executes INT8 inference (0.01 ms @ 40 mA), writes to RTC memory, and returns to Deep Sleep (10 uA). Consumes ~0.00013 Joules per reading.
Edge Advantage: Edge uses > 15,000x LESS energy per prediction than cloud inference.
Doorbell Application Context: Directly achieves the project's goal: local inference prevents draining the very battery it is trying to monitor!

Cloud / Server Inference: Total failure when home Wi-Fi drops, ISP suffers an outage, router reboots, or cloud server experiences downtime. Device cannot predict battery life.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: 100% autonomous operation. Operates seamlessly during power blackouts, internet outages, or in rural off-grid cabins.
Edge Advantage: Total offline resilience and self-contained operation.
Doorbell Application Context: Doorbell continues monitoring and warning the user even if internet connectivity is lost.

Cloud / Server Inference: Dependent on multi-tiered infrastructure: DNS servers, internet routing, load balancers, FastAPI/uvicorn processes, and container orchestration.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: Single-chip bare-metal/FreeRTOS embedded firmware with hardware watchdog timer (WDT) reset recovery. MTBF > 100,000 hours.
Edge Advantage: Hardware-level reliability without external service dependencies.
Doorbell Application Context: High availability critical for security and safety appliances.

Cloud / Server Inference: Virtually unconstrained: Servers offer 8 GB – 64 GB+ RAM. Can host massive ensemble models, gradient-boosted trees, and large deep networks without size concerns.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: Strictly constrained: ESP32-S3 offers 512 KB SRAM (300 KB budget) and 8 MB PSRAM. Architecture must be capped at w <= 256 (Float32) or w <= 512 (Int8).
Edge Advantage: Server wins on capacity; Edge demands aggressive model optimization and quantization.
Doorbell Application Context: Requires the engineering rigor performed in Mission 4 (INT8 quantization, buffer reuse) to fit into SRAM.

Cloud / Server Inference: Centralized bottleneck: 1,000,000 active doorbells sending periodic readings generate high request loads, requiring database clustering, auto-scaling, and Redis caching.
ESP32-S3 Edge Inference: Inherently decentralized: Every newly deployed doorbell brings its own dedicated 240 MHz Xtensa dual-core processor. Scaling is O(1).
Edge Advantage: Zero server scaling infrastructure required as customer base expands.
Doorbell Application Context: Company can scale from 1,000 to 10,000,000 devices without redesigning cloud infrastructure.
